$comment: Generated by node scripts/ci/refresh-chat-shard-durations.mjs from the CI profile test records of the PR chat jobs (profile-ci label). Per collected test entry, keyed by the name that vitest list reports: the summed duration of every case that entry runs, so an it.each line carries all its cases. Median across the given runs. scripts/test-line-shard.mjs uses these weights only to place source lines on chat partitions; they never change which tests run. Missing entries take the median weight.
